note: Atomic misconceptions split from staff `common_mistakes` in the 6.006 quiz solutions. origin='staff' is ground truth; anything added later for the problem-set questions must be marked origin='generated'.

misconceptions.label: heap-order vs traversal-order indexing
misconceptions.description: Indexes nodes by heap order rather than traversal order.

misconceptions.label: one-indexing instead of zero-indexing
misconceptions.description: Uses one-indexed positions where the problem uses zero-indexing.

misconceptions.label: reports full traversal instead of leaves
misconceptions.description: Lists every node in the traversal rather than only the leaves.

misconceptions.label: delete without AVL rebalance
misconceptions.description: Deletes the item but does not rebalance to restore the AVL property.

misconceptions.label: third-smallest must be a near-root node
misconceptions.description: Assumes the third-smallest item must be one of a specific pair of nodes (B or C) rather than any node consistent with the ordering.

misconceptions.label: maximum must be on the bottom level
misconceptions.description: Believes the largest integer must sit at the bottom level, rather than at any leaf.

misconceptions.label: heap-order vs traversal-order when building
misconceptions.description: Builds the heap by confusing heap order with traversal order.

misconceptions.label: incorrect extremal delete
misconceptions.description: Deletes the extremal item without swapping the root with the last leaf and heapifying down.

misconceptions.label: non-linear sort where O(n) required
misconceptions.description: Uses a sorting algorithm that is not O(n) when a linear-time sort is required.

misconceptions.label: optimality asserted without justification
misconceptions.description: Claims O(n log n) is optimal without giving the lower-bound argument.

misconceptions.label: spurious Omega(n log n) lower bound
misconceptions.description: Argues an Omega(n log n) comparison lower bound in a setting where it does not apply.

misconceptions.label: tree depth confused with node count
misconceptions.description: Claims there are only ceil(3 log n) + 4 ancestors rather than O(2^(ceil(3 log n)+4)) nodes.

misconceptions.label: mis-simplifying an exponential bound
misconceptions.description: Claims 2^(ceil(3 log n)+4) = O(n) and therefore reaches for counting sort.

misconceptions.label: integer sort without a bounded universe
misconceptions.description: Uses counting sort, radix sort, or a direct-access array despite no bound on the integer universe.

misconceptions.label: amortized bound claimed for hash insertions
misconceptions.description: Says n hash-table insertions give an amortized bound where expected/worst-case is what is needed.

misconceptions.label: brute-force triple enumeration
misconceptions.description: Checks all triples in Omega(n^3) time instead of a subquadratic-per-pair approach.

misconceptions.label: query direction inverted
misconceptions.description: Finds v from i rather than i from v.

misconceptions.label: stops at first left-child link
misconceptions.description: Stops early on encountering a left-child link instead of continuing up to the root.

misconceptions.label: walks down from the root
misconceptions.description: Walks downward from the root while assuming which route leads to v.

misconceptions.label: minimum taken within one pipe
misconceptions.description: Takes a minimum within an individual pipe instead of over all pipes.

misconceptions.label: multi-hole pipes not prioritized
misconceptions.description: Does not prioritize pipes with multiple holes over pipes with only one hole.

misconceptions.label: structure over all pipes misses bounds
misconceptions.description: Stores an AVL tree or heap over all pipes in a way that cannot meet the required bounds.

misconceptions.label: augmentation used incorrectly
misconceptions.description: Applies tree augmentation in a way that does not actually support the query.

misconceptions.label: O(log n) insertion into a sorted array
misconceptions.description: Claims O(log n) insertion into a sorted array (search is O(log n); insertion is O(n)).

misconceptions.label: non-polynomial direct-access array
misconceptions.description: Initializes a direct-access array whose size is not polynomial in the input.

misconceptions.label: Sequence AVL instead of Set AVL
misconceptions.description: Uses Sequence AVL trees where Set AVL trees are required.

misconceptions.label: maximum range must cross the root
misconceptions.description: Assumes the maximum range always passes through the root.

misconceptions.label: augmentation without O(1) maintenance
misconceptions.description: Claims a substring augmentation without showing it is maintainable in O(1) time.

misconceptions.label: separate trees for active/inactive
misconceptions.description: Uses separate AVL trees for active and inactive users.

misconceptions.label: root-spanning substrings ignored
misconceptions.description: Fails to consider substrings that contain the root when maintaining the augmentation.

misconceptions.label: repeated O(1) op treated as amortized O(m)
misconceptions.description: Says that performing an O(1)-time operation m times takes amortized O(m) time, conflating total work with the amortized per-operation bound.

misconceptions.label: repeated O(1) op treated as amortized O(m)
misconceptions.description: Says that performing an O(1)-time operation m times takes amortized O(m) time, conflating total work with the amortized per-operation bound.
